summary: A full sync must not prune local rows after a windowed fetch: the /transactions date window, --since and any --param/--resource-param filter skip flat reconcile.
reason: The 4.33.0 generator prunes the whole local table against the IDs a --full sync saw; Hostex transactions are always fetched through a 365-day window, so pruning would delete older history backfilled with --resource-param.
validated_outcome: TestFullSyncPrunesOnlyWholeTableFetches: the transactions window and --since keep older rows, a whole-table fetch still prunes dropped rows; the test fails without the guard.
